title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has released the minutes from its latest Junior Selection Committee meeting, detailing decisions impacting young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has published the minutes of the Junior Selection Committee meeting held on October 19, 2026, outlining key decisions for junior player development and selections.

title: BAI Announces Formation of New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The establishment of the BAI Athletes Committee provides Indian badminton players with a formal voice in the sport's governance and decision-making processes.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aiming to give players a greater say in the sport's administration.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's top junior talent is currently training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati to prepare for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 commenced on September 24, 2026, at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, bringing together India's promising young shuttlers.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati and Raipur
indian_angle: Indian coaches are undergoing advanced training through the BAI Level-1 Coaches Course, enhancing coaching standards across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) conducted its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026, aimed at upskilling domestic coaches.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships
indian_angle: The Indian junior team is participating in a dedicated coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 was held at the National Center of Excellence (NCE) in Guwahati, focusing on preparing young talents for the continental event.
